name: telegram-agent-estate
description: One plugin: run a personal Claude agent as a Telegram-driven daemon on macOS. An owned long-poll receiver journals every inbound message to a durable receipt WAL; a flock-serialized runner answers it with one `claude -p --resume` per turn. Crash-safe, exactly-once, subscription-billed.
